source.scope: Supplied 2014 code checked against city-hosted document. This is not certification of all later amendments.

vendor_id.requirement: Vendor or helper must have a Market Identification Card; display requires an explicit display rule in the note.

liquor.requirement: Observed drinking, serving or dispensing liquor inside the city market.

dress.requirement: Required apron and prohibited sando or exposed torso while vending; knee-length walking shorts are expressly allowed.

blade_storage.requirement: Non-use storage must be locked; utensil retail displays are excepted.

blade_carry.requirement: Carrying outside vending area or transferring without opaque covering; utensil retail displays are excepted.

grease.requirement: Stall sinks require p-traps and grease traps.

dwelling.requirement: Conversion of stall to temporary or permanent dwelling; sleeping alone without dwelling use is insufficient.

children.requirement: Parents must not allow their children to play in or around market stalls.

animals.requirement: Dogs and other animals must not be left astray in market zone.

mobile_registration.requirement: Mobile vendor registration and ID; missing ordinary vendor ID remains Vendor Identification.

description_required: Safety equipment duty, inspection interval or expiry requirement for extinguisher findings
Specific approval conditions for promotion, advertising, streamer and entertainment findings
Active closure or suspension plus continued prohibited trading
Verified unpaid amount or ledger discrepancy for fees and rent

category_boundaries.Stall Construction: Physical work and its approval belong here, not Permit & Licensing.
category_boundaries.WeightMeasures: Scale registration, seals and measurement faults belong here, not Permit & Licensing.
category_boundaries.Illegal Vendor: Location/mobile-vending authorization; exclude utility jumper and ordinary business certificate.
category_boundaries.Permit & Licensing: Business/activity permit or required health certificate; exclude construction, events and sidewalk permits.
category_boundaries.Market Rules: Specific operating rules; do not duplicate findings already covered by an explicit category.
category_boundaries.Stall Occupancy: Unauthorized occupant or space relative to award/contract; dwelling itself belongs to Market Rules.
